title: Coming out after retirement: Daily Mail and Ty Roberts interviews
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Coming out after retirement: Daily Mail and Ty Roberts interviews, about 2025 at UK Daily Mail; International UFO Bureau (Oklahoma City), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: UK Daily Mail; International UFO Bureau (Oklahoma City)

tellings.quote: >> on on the 4th of May, uh Josh Boswell came out with uh an interview uh from the UK Daily Mail.

plain: Greg Rogers, a doctor who says he worked with NASA and saw a UFO inside a secret hangar, says he only went public after he retired. He says that on 4 May 2025 a journalist named Josh Boswell published an interview with him in the UK newspaper the Daily Mail, and that he also spoke with Ty Roberts of the International UFO Bureau in Oklahoma City for an interview called Total Disclosure. He tells it to explain how and why his story came out when it did.
